description: This is a C header file defining functions related to executing Git commands, handling the executable path, and preparing command arguments.

methods.name: git_set_exec_path
methods.description: Sets the path where Git executable resides.

methods.name: git_resolve_executable_dir
methods.description: Resolves the directory of the given executable path.

methods.name: git_exec_path
methods.description: Returns the current Git executable path.

methods.name: prepare_git_cmd
methods.description: Prepares a Git command for execution, populating the output vector.

methods.name: execv_git_cmd
methods.description: Executes a Git command using execv with the provided argument vector.

methods.name: execl_git_cmd
methods.description: Executes a Git command with execl, passing command and arguments.

methods.name: system_path
methods.description: Returns the system-specific path for a given executable.
